pyramiding_rule: Absolute ban on averaging down or sequential order stacking within a 2-pip window; enforce minimum 15-pip spatial distribution between stacked fills.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero execution permitted during the initial 15-minute window of high-impact macro data releases; order book imbalance must exceed 65% in favor of the trade direction.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation once unrealized profit hits $4.00 to prevent positive expectancy from decaying into negative territory.
